verdict.rationale: Bolt documents an authentication option in Bolt Database that lets an app's users sign up with their email address (bolt-docs-34). Supabase can also be connected to add authentication services (bolt-docs-22, bolt-docs-36). That covers the email half of the story, but nothing shows social or OAuth provider login, and there is no detail on login flows or UI the builder scaffolds. Missing for 10: evidence of social/OAuth provider sign-in, documentation of scaffolded login/sign-up UI and flows, independent hands-on corroboration.
